category.name: BarCode Image
category.preferred_workflow: Insert a typed FieldDisplayBarcode via DocumentBuilder.InsertField(FieldType.FieldDisplayBarcode, true), set explicit properties (BarcodeType, BarcodeValue, ForegroundColor, BackgroundColor, ScalingFactor), assign a custom IBarcodeGenerator to Document.FieldOptions.BarcodeGenerator for non-DOCX outputs, call doc.UpdateFields(), and finally save the document in the desired format.

strict_api_bans: Never use unqualified BarcodeParameters; always reference Aspose.Words.Fields.BarcodeParameters.
Never use unqualified Font; always reference Aspose.Drawing.Font.
Never use unqualified Color; always reference Aspose.Drawing.Color.
Never import System.Drawing types in this category.
Do not insert DISPLAYBARCODE fields using string syntax or builder.InsertField with a raw field code.
canonical_patterns: Create barcode fields with the typed FieldDisplayBarcode object, assign properties directly, register a custom IBarcodeGenerator, update fields, and save the document.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate that BarcodeValue, BarcodeType, and color strings are non-null before assigning them to a FieldDisplayBarcode.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler reports an ambiguous reference for 'Font' or 'BarcodeParameters' between Aspose.Drawing and Aspose.Words namespaces.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Unqualified type names cause the C# compiler to see multiple matching types from different assemblies.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Qualify the type with its full namespace (e.g., Aspose.Drawing.Font, Aspose.Words.Fields.BarcodeParameters).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always use fully qualified names or explicit using aliases for these types.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 errors for Height, Width, SetSwitch, SetFieldCode, or Orientation members that do not exist on FieldDisplayBarcode.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Attempting to control barcode appearance through legacy field switches instead of the typed API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use supported typed properties such as ScalingFactor, ForegroundColor, BackgroundColor, and rely on a custom generator for size adjustments.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Do not call non-existent members; consult the API reference for available FieldDisplayBarcode properties.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0117 or CS0723 errors when assigning SymbologyEncodeType values to EncodeTypes or using undefined EncodeTypes members.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Confusing the static EncodeTypes class with the SymbologyEncodeType enum used by Aspose.BarCode.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Map barcode type strings to SymbologyEncodeType values (e.g., EncodeTypes.Code128) and avoid treating EncodeTypes as an enum.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always use SymbologyEncodeType for generator construction and keep the mapping logic isolated.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0234 errors for namespaces such as Aspose.Words.Building, Aspose.Words.Nodes, or Aspose.Words.LoadOptions.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Incorrect or outdated using directives referencing non-existent namespaces in the installed package version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove invalid namespaces and import only existing ones like Aspose.Words.Drawing and Aspose.Words.Replacing.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify namespace availability against the current Aspose.Words version before adding using statements.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime FileNotFoundException or DirectoryNotFoundException when loading template documents or processing folders.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Example code assumes external assets without creating or checking them.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create temporary sample files/folders within the example or guard file-system operations with existence checks.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Ensure all required assets are provisioned programmatically before they are accessed.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0103 error indicating that 'ImageFormat' does not exist in the current context.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Missing reference to Aspose.Drawing.Imaging or accidental reliance on System.Drawing types.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always import the Aspose.Drawing.Imaging namespace when working with image formats.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1061 errors for missing members such as BarcodeSymbology, BarcodeForeColor, or FieldName on BarcodeParameters.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Using the wrong BarcodeParameters type (Aspose.BarCode.Generation) or assuming properties that are not part of Aspose.Words.Fields.BarcodeParameters.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Reference Aspose.Words.Fields.BarcodeParameters and set only the properties defined there.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words.Fields.BarcodeParameters documentation to use supported members only.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: 504 Gateway Time-out during code generation or execution.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Temporary network or service latency unrelated to the source code.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Retry the operation or allow the alternate engine result when the example otherwise passes verification.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Implement retry logic with exponential back-off for external service calls.

narrative.overview: The BarCode Image category demonstrates how to embed and render barcodes in Word documents using Aspose.Words and Aspose.BarCode. Verified examples show typed FieldDisplayBarcode usage, custom IBarcodeGenerator implementations, and PDF export with correctly rendered barcode images.
narrative.purpose: Guide an AI coding agent to generate, customize, and validate barcode fields in Word documents while adhering to strict API usage rules and employing a custom barcode generator for rendered outputs such as PDF.
validation_priorities: After updating fields, verify that the generated PDF contains barcode images of the expected type and dimensions.
maintenance_notes: Keep the Aspose.Words, Aspose.BarCode, and Aspose.Drawing.Common package versions synchronized and update using directives when libraries are upgraded.
